value.lineage: PicoSAT (2007-, JKU Linz, Armin Biere): compact CDCL SAT solver with aggressive clause learning, phase saving and a trace/proof mode; a distinct CDCL lineage from MiniSat and the ancestor of PrecoSAT/Lingeling

value.built_to: decide propositional satisfiability and emit a model or an UNSAT proof trace, in a small self-contained solver
value.pressure: the same industrial CNF pressure as MiniSat, plus a demand for checkable UNSAT proofs (the trace mode)
value.success_means: correct SAT/UNSAT, models that satisfy the clauses, and a replayable resolution proof on UNSAT

ANCESTRY.value: PicoSAT (2007-, JKU Linz, Armin Biere): compact CDCL SAT solver with aggressive clause learning, phase saving and a trace/proof mode; a distinct CDCL lineage from MiniSat and the ancestor of PrecoSAT/Lingeling

cut.note: a CDCL solver of the same family as MiniSat (cut DEEP in this atlas) read for its differences: phase saving is built in with a running statistic of how often the saved phase was flipped; propagation uses head/tail watches with separate implication lists for binary clauses (by inventory: setimpl, connect_head_tail, propl); the variable score is a float in a heap with rescoring on overflow; restarts follow the Luby sequence scaled by 100 conflicts (or a geometric schedule under a compile flag) and the learnt-clause limit grows by its own schedule; the solver can emit a proof trace and handles assumptions and all-different constraints

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.human_name: assign_phase (1579-1600): new_phase from the literal's sign; if the variable was assigned before, sdflips -= sdflips / FFLIPPED and, when the phase differs, the flip statistic is bumped; v->phase saved; decide uses the saved phase (sdecide, not read)
organs.mechanism: whenever a variable is assigned, its polarity is remembered; a later decision on that variable reuses the remembered polarity, so after a restart or a backjump the solver re-enters the region of the search space it was in (progress saving); a decayed counter of how often the saved phase is contradicted is kept as a health statistic
assumptions: partial assignments found before a restart are worth keeping (Pipatsrisawat & Darwiche 2007); the flip statistic is cheap diagnostics
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: restarts stop throwing away work; one of the two changes (with Luby restarts) that made frequent restarting pay
organs.human_prior: Pipatsrisawat & Darwiche 2007 (phase saving); MiniSat 2.2's polarity vector is the simpler form

organs.human_name: luby (4830-4843), inc_lrestart (4856-4875): delta = 100 * luby(++lubycnt); lrestart = conflicts + delta; NLUBY: inc_drestart / inc_ddrestart geometric by FRESTART percent up to MAXRESTART; need_to_reduce (4810): nlclauses >= reduce_limit_on_lclauses; inc_lreduce (4550)
organs.mechanism: the next restart is scheduled at the current conflict count plus 100 times the next Luby number (1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 2, 4, ...); a compile-time alternative multiplies an interval by a percentage up to a cap (the older geometric scheme); independently, the learnt-clause database is reduced when its size crosses a limit that grows on its own schedule; reports mark the largest Luby deltas
assumptions: Luby's universal schedule bounds the loss from any fixed cutoff; decoupling the reduce schedule from restarts lets each be tuned
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the 100-conflict unit is a constant; Glucose-style dynamic restarts (on LBD) came later
organs.source_boundary: the restart and reduce schedule functions

organs.human_name: inc_score (3449-3475): r->score = addflt(score, vinc); hup; vrescore (3436), crescore (4436) for clauses; decide (5874-5895): adecide (assumptions), rdecide (random), sdecide (scored)
organs.mechanism: each variable has a rank record with a float score; a bump adds the current increment and sifts the record up the heap; the increment grows per conflict and everything is rescaled when it would overflow (the MiniSat trick in float form); clause activities likewise; a decision first satisfies pending assumptions, else with some probability picks a random variable, else the heap maximum; the saved phase gives the sign
assumptions: VSIDS; assumptions as a decision prefix make incremental solving (solve under assumptions) natural
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: incremental SAT for bounded model checking (the author's use)
organs.source_boundary: the scoring and decide functions; CANDIDATE because sdecide was not read

rejected_cuts.candidate: propagation (bcp, propl, the head/tail watch scheme and binary implication lists: setimpl / connect_head_tail), conflict analysis (analyze, fanalyze), clause minimisation, the clause allocator and garbage collection, the proof trace (RUP / extended resolution output), the ADO extension, simplification, failed-literal probing, the API and the app
rejected_cuts.note: the head/tail watch scheme with binary lists is the propagation variant that distinguishes this lineage from MiniSat's two-watched-literal + blocker; it is the DEEP item to read next

rejected_cuts.evidence: the atlas's minisat cut names the five separable policies; this cut records where PicoSAT's differ

pressures.source_evidence: picosat.c assign_phase, the restart functions, decide; the trace functions by name
pressures.condition: an organism answers a sequence of related SAT queries (bounded model checking) each under a set of assumed literals; frequent restarts are needed for heavy tails; an unsatisfiable answer must come with a proof a third party can check; the score is total time over the sequence and proof validity
pressures.failure_condition: restarts that discard progress (time), or an UNSAT answer without a checkable proof
pressures.world_punishes: restarting with fresh polarities; proofs reconstructed after the fact
pressures.world_rewards: phase saving, Luby restarts, a trace recorded during search
pressures.observable_consequence: time over a BMC unrolling sequence with phase saving on and off; proof check success rate on the UNSAT instances
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: re-solving from scratch per query (correct, slow)
pressures.cheat_control: an organism given the previous query's model as the initial phase must match phase saving's time; phase saving off must show the time penalty on the sequence; an UNSAT answer with tracing off must fail the proof check: the world must show all three
